physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Butterfly Cluster is recorded: it is an extended star cluster, and its package frames it at 9.2 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), Hunt & Reffert's tidal radius estimate, a presentation value.

sources.position: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II.
